headline: Blind-Spots-Bench: A New Benchmark to Uncover Multimodal AI Weaknesses
reasoning: This paper introduces a novel and significant benchmark specifically designed to identify 'blind spots' in multimodal AI models, addressing a critical gap in current evaluation methods. Its focus on challenging tasks that are simple for humans but difficult for AI, coupled with a robust evaluation pipeline and analysis of frontier models, provides high technical credibility and direct relevance to AI research and development.
summary: Researchers have developed 'Blind-Spots-Bench,' a new benchmark to evaluate and expose specific weaknesses in multimodal AI models that perform well on existing benchmarks but fail on human-trivial tasks. The benchmark reveals performance gaps between open-source and closed-source models and highlights areas where all current models struggle.

source_articles.title: Blind-Spots-Bench: Evaluating Blind Spots in Multimodal Models
